newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Petro down after placement news.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Petro down after placement news.

text.p: Shares of Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd fell on dilution fears after the company announced a placement of new shares, brokers said.

"Anticipation of dilution following the placement triggered selling," said a sales manager at a local brokerage. "A trading discount with the placement price also led to an expectation of room on the downside and that triggered selling."
The company shares fell HK$0.075 or 3.06 percent to HK$2.375 at midday on Tuesday after a one-day suspension on Monday. Volume was 17.59 million shares worth HK$42.60 million.

Shanghai Petrochemical said on Monday it would issue and place 150 million new H-shares at HK$2.28 each, raising about HK$333.4 million net proceeds to fund its capital expansion programme and for working capital.
H-shares are Hong Kong-listed shares in China-incorporated companies.
